exitNodeHelpTooltip.text.anExitNodeIsA: An exit node is a network route that routes all your internet traffic through one of your peers.
exitNodePeerIndicator.text.thisPeerIsAnA: This peer is an auto-applied exit node. Traffic from the configured distribution groups will be routed through this peer.
exitNodePeerIndicator.text.thisPeerIsAnE: This peer is an exit node. Traffic from the configured distribution groups will be routed through this peer.
